questions.stem: Which property controls the changes in cost and resource plans with respect to the change in the start date of a demand or project?

options.text: ‘Change Resource Plan, Cost Plan and Benefit Plan Start Date with Demand or Project Start Date Change’.
‘Enable altering of planned date for task in WIP/Closed’.
‘Calculate ROI percentage based on a project's estimated cost and its net value’.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Date Change Property: The property 'Change Resource Plan, Cost Plan and Benefit Plan Start Date with Demand or Project Start Date Change' (A) controls shifts in cost and resource plans when a demand or project start date changes. Per p1195: this property cascades date changes to associated cost, resource, and benefit plans. ROI calculation (D) and rollup start date from tasks (C) properties serve different purposes.

questions.stem: Which statement defines the Project Workspace?

options.text: A central location to view of all projects in a portfolio to prioritize work
A central location for creating and managing projects
A central location for viewing and assessing business demands
A central location transform the navigation of lists and forms into an interactive graphical experience

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Definition: Project Workspace is a central location for creating and managing projects (B). It provides project managers with a unified interface to manage all project activities, tasks, resources, and financials. Portfolio view (A) is Portfolio Workbench. Demand assessment (C) is Demand Workbench. Interactive graphical navigation (D) describes a different ServiceNow UI feature.

questions.stem: If a sub-project and parent project have different project currencies, this property should be set to true for cost roll-ups.
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Multicurrency Rollup: The property com.snc.project.multicurrency.rollup_if_different (C) must be set to true to enable cost rollup when sub-project and parent project have different currencies. Per p1237: when true, the system rolls up costs across currency boundaries using conversion rates. rollup_project_start_date (A) and calculate_roi (B) control different behaviors. copy.additional_attributes (D) handles attribute copying.

questions.stem: When can a user choose from multiple rate types for their work, while logging a time card?

options.text: Only if this capability is enabled in the Project Record
Only one (1) rate type can apply
Only if the capability is enabled in the Time Sheet Policies
Only if the capability is enabled in the Project Preferences

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Time Cards > Multiple Rate Types: A user can choose from multiple rate types when logging a time card only if the capability is enabled in the Time Sheet Policies (C). Per p1564: 'Allow multiple rate types: Option to provide a rate type' is a Time Sheet Policy setting. This setting is not configured on the Project Record (A), Project Preferences (D), or as a hardcoded single-rate constraint (B).

questions.stem: If Scenario Planning for PPM is installed, a portfolio manager can access the Portfolio Planning Workbench by navigating to which of the following? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Access Points: With Scenario Planning for PPM installed, Portfolio Planning Workbench is accessible from the Portfolio Planning Workbench module (B) in the application navigator and from the Portfolio Planning related link (D) on the portfolio form. Per p1534: these are the two starting points. Project module (A) and Program Workbench (C) do not provide access to the Portfolio Planning Workbench.

questions.stem: What is the first step in the process when configuring Portfolio Planning to work with ServiceNow® Project Portfolio Management?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Configuration First Step: The first step in configuring Portfolio Planning to work with ServiceNow PPM is to create an alignment integration (A). Per p67: '1. Create an alignment integration. 2. Generate default mapping configurations. 3. Create custom mapping configurations.' Generating default mappings (B) and custom mapping configurations (D) come after the alignment integration is created.

questions.stem: Which role should be assigned to a user so they can read and retrieve data from any table of the Release Management application to generate reports?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Release Management > Reporting Role: The Business stakeholder role (C) allows a user to read and retrieve data from any table of the Release Management application to generate reports. Per p2199: 'Use the business stakeholder role to read and retrieve data from any table... to generate reports.' This read-only reporting role is consistent across PPM applications. Project manager (A) and release admin (B) have operational access, not just reporting.

questions.stem: Which plugin activates the Ideas module to gather and evaluate ideas efficiently, and quickly identify ideas for implementation?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Innovation > Ideas Plugin: The Ideation with PPM plugin (A) activates the Ideas module. Per p1806: 'Ideation with PPM [com.snc.ppm_innovation_management] Enables your organization to collect new ideas, collaborate on ideas, and identify great ideas for implementation.' Agile Development 2.0 (B) is for sprint planning. Resource Management (C) and Test Management 2.0 (D) are separate applications.

questions.stem: In order to map custom fields from Microsoft Project to ServiceNow when importing a project, you must first:

options.text: Export the project to XML format
Create custom fields in your ServiceNow instance

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > MS Project Import: To map custom fields from Microsoft Project to ServiceNow, you must first create custom fields in your ServiceNow instance (B). The custom destination fields must exist before import mapping can reference them. Exporting to XML (A) is the MS Project export step. Configuring the Project form (C) and importing (D) come after the fields are created.

questions.stem: Can an it_project_manager convert a task to a milestone?

options.text: No, this can only be done by a system admin.
Yes, by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console.
No, the PPS admin role is also required.
Yes, if the task is assigned to the project manager.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Milestone Conversion: Yes, an it_project_manager can convert a task to a milestone by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console (B). Per p1086: 'You can also convert a task to milestone through Planning console tasks.' Tasks with duration 0 appear as milestones. Admin role (A) is not required. PPS admin (C) is not needed. Task assignment to the PM (D) is not a prerequisite.

questions.stem: Use this table to configure the parameters displayed on a project card on the My Projects Space page of the Project Workspace.
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Card Configuration: The PM Home Page Configuration [pm_home_page_config] table (C) configures parameters displayed on project cards in the My Projects Space page. Per p1344: 'Set the display columns for row 2 of the card in PM Home Page Configuration [pm_home_page_config] table.' pm_toplevel_project (A) and pm_project (D) are project data tables, not configuration tables for card display.

questions.stem: As a demand manager, you can view an artifact from a demand. What artifacts are part of a demand?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Artifacts: Artifacts of a demand include Project, Defect, and Requests (B). Per p986: 'Project, Enhancement, Change, or Defect: If a demand is accepted, the pop-up window displays the current state of the resulting artifact.' A demand can result in a project, defect, or change request. Stories and Vulnerability Tasks (A) are Agile/Security items. Incidents, Problems, Change (C) are ITSM records. Decision, Risk, Requirements (D) are RIDAC elements, not demand artifacts.

questions.stem: When creating a project from demand, what related records are moved and copied upon Project Creation?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Project Creation Records: When creating a project from a demand, Resource Plan and Change Requests (B) are moved and copied. Resource plans associated with the demand propagate to the new project. Change requests linked to the demand also transfer. Cost Plan and Assessment (A) is not the standard pairing. Resource Plan and Cost Plan (C) is close but the doc indicates resource plans and associated change requests. Idea and Demand (D) are not project creation outputs.

questions.stem: If an it_project_manager does not want to equally distribute hours across the resource plan time frame, what allocation spread should be used?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resource Plans > Allocation Spread: To NOT equally distribute hours across the resource plan time frame, the project manager should use Any (C) allocation spread. 'Any' allows custom, non-uniform distribution of hours. Even (D) explicitly splits hours evenly — which is the opposite of what is needed. Front Load (A) and Back Load (B) are specific patterns. 'Any' provides the flexibility to distribute hours in any non-equal manner.

questions.stem: If the ‘Move project for WIP projects’ property is enabled, project tasks associated with the project are also moved, except for tasks in which of the following states? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > WIP Move Property: When 'Move project for WIP projects' is enabled, project tasks in Work in Progress (A) and Closed (B) states are NOT moved. Tasks already in progress or closed should not have their dates shifted by a project-level date change. Open (D) and Pending (C) tasks are eligible to be moved along with the project schedule change.

questions.stem: Depending on the execution type selected for a particular project, one of these dashboards will also be available:
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Analytics > Execution Type Dashboard: Depending on the execution type, the Project Summary - Waterfall Dashboard (D) will also be available. Per p1346: analytics widgets and reports are available for Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid execution types. Each execution type has a corresponding dashboard. User Manager Dashboard (A) and Timecard Dashboard (B) are separate. PMO Dashboard (C) is for portfolio-level reporting.

questions.stem: The Project management application supports two types of external dependencies. What are they? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > External Dependency Types: The two types of external dependencies are Hard Dependency (B) and Soft Dependency (D). Per p1054: 'The Project management application supports two types of external dependencies - hard and soft.' Hard dependencies auto-propagate changes; soft dependencies generate notifications. Change Dependency (A), Task Dependency (C), and Milestone Dependency (E) are not the external dependency types.

questions.stem: The combination of the user and the assigned portfolio must be unique when adding a user to which registry?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio > Stakeholder Registry: The combination of user and assigned portfolio must be unique when adding a user to the Stakeholder Registry (A). Per p1036: the Stakeholder Register Form manages portfolio stakeholders with unique user-portfolio combinations. Application Registry (B) is for app management. UX Page Registry (C) is for UI configuration. Event Registry (D) is for system events.

questions.stem: Where do you define ‘Roles’ requested via resource plans?

options.text: No need to define it differently, they are same as system roles.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Role Definition: 'Roles' requested via resource plans are defined under Resource roles in Resource Management (B). These are separate from system security roles — resource roles represent job functions or skill categories used in resource planning. System security roles (A) are for access control. Skill management (C) handles skills, not resource plan roles. Resource roles are a distinct entity (D is false).

questions.stem: Where is planned cost calculated from when requesting resources from a group and when resource role is specified?

options.text: The hourly rate of the specified role.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Planned Cost Calculation: When requesting resources from a group with a specified resource role, planned cost is calculated from the hourly rate of the specified role (C). Per p1461: 'While requesting resources from a group, if a resource role is specified, the planned cost is calculated from the hourly rate of the specified role.' Task rate cards (A) and CI rate cards (D) are not used for this calculation. Distribution costs (B) are not the source.

questions.stem: Which is the minimum role that has access to the Project Administration > Settings > Preferences-Project module?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Admin > Minimum Role: The minimum role for Project Administration > Settings > Preferences-Project module is it_pps_admin (A). Per p1815: the PPS admin role can view and modify project administration settings. it_project_manager (B) and it_program_manager (C) are operational roles without admin configuration access. sys_admin (D) also has access but is not the minimum required role.

questions.stem: What is a data copy of the current project's task, schedule, or structure that can be used for comparison reporting later?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Baseline: A Baseline (B) is a data copy of the current project's task, schedule, or structure used for comparison reporting later. Per p1276: 'A baseline is a snapshot of the project's progress at the particular moment of time.' Commitment (A) is a resource confirmation. Accrual (C) is an accounting term for recognized costs. Forecast (D) is a projection of future values.

questions.stem: If a lens has four entities, which entity within the lens structure would not have a parent reference?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Strategic Planning > Lens Structure: The top-level entity (C) in a lens would not have a parent reference. Per p32: 'Ensure that every entity, except the top-level, has a parent entity reference.' The top-level entity is the root of the lens hierarchy. Second-level (A), bottom (B), and third-level (D) entities all require a parent reference to the entity above them in the structure.

questions.stem: Which role can configure the parameters of the demand workbench that is provided with the base system?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Workbench Configuration Role: The it_pps_admin role (A) can configure parameters of the demand workbench. Per p960: 'Role required: it_pps_admin' for configuring the demand workbench. it_project_manager (B) manages projects. All roles (C) is incorrect — configuration access is restricted. business_stakeholder (D) has read-only reporting access.

questions.stem: What are the default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Template Config Records: The default project template configuration records are Project subtask (B), Project (C), and Project task (D). Per p1115: the Project Template Configuration list includes pm_project (root/top), project task, and project subtask as the default items. Project template (A) is the template object itself, not a configuration record. Task (E) is a generic task table, not a default template config record.

questions.stem: What is the default table that stores the idea categories that a user can select from when submitting an idea?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Innovation > Idea Categories Table: The im_category table (B) stores the idea categories a user can select when submitting an idea. This is the default category table for the Ideas module. im_idea_core (A) stores the actual idea records. im_module (C) stores idea module configurations. dmn_demand (D) stores demand records, not idea categories.

questions.stem: A user's availability is calculated as:

options.text: Allocated hours divided by the total capacity
Sum of allocated and confirmed hours, divided by the total capacity

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Availability Formula: A user's availability is calculated as Capacity minus Allocation (D). Available hours = total capacity hours minus the hours already allocated to tasks. Allocated hours divided by capacity (A) is the utilization formula. Allocated time alone (B) is not availability. Sum of allocated and confirmed hours divided by capacity (C) is the Forecasted Utilization formula.

questions.stem: The project property to update actual effort from time card is controlled at what level?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Time Cards > Actual Effort Update: The property to update actual effort from time cards is controlled at the Project Level (C). Individual projects can be configured to allow time card data to roll up as actual effort. Portfolio Level (A) is for financial planning. Application Level (B) would be a global setting. Program Level (D) is for program management, not time card actual effort configuration.

questions.stem: What minimum role is required to assign a time sheet policy to a user?

options.text: It is not possible to assign a time sheet policy to a user.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Time Sheets > Policy Assignment Role: The minimum role to assign a time sheet policy to a user is timecard_admin (A). Per p1564: 'Role required: timecard_admin' for setting time sheet policies as default and assigning them to users. ppm_admin (B) is not a standard role for this function. it_project_manager (D) manages projects, not time sheet policy assignments.

questions.stem: What is a resource event?

options.text: A block of time that a resource spends on a task.
An event scheduled by a project manager.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Resource Event: A resource event is a block of time that a resource spends on a task (B). Per p1441: when a resource manager makes an allocation, calendar events are created for the resource within their work schedule. A non-scheduled activity impacting capacity (A) describes an exception. An external event (C) is unrelated. An event scheduled by a PM (D) partially describes it but is imprecise.

questions.stem: What is the demand workbench used for? (Choose two.)

options.text: Comparing and prioritizing demands against other demands

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Workbench Purpose: The demand workbench is used for approving demands (B) and comparing and prioritizing demands against other demands (C). Per p963: it 'provides a single point of engagement for assessing and approving demands' using interactive bubble charts. Approving ideas (A) is done through the Ideas module. Comparing demands with portfolios (D) is a Portfolio Workbench function.

questions.stem: If a user creates a new demand from the demand workbench, what state will the system save the record in?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Workbench Creation State: When a user creates a new demand from the demand workbench, the system saves the record in the Qualified state (D). Per p964: 'Demands created from the Demand Workbench are in the Qualified state.' Demands created from other locations start in Draft state. Approved (A), open (B), and draft (C) are other demand states but not the initial state from the workbench.

questions.stem: What is the formula for Committed Utilization?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Committed Utilization: The formula for Committed Utilization is Allocated Hours / Capacity (A). Committed utilization measures the ratio of fully committed (hard-allocated) hours to total capacity. Assigned Hours/Capacity (B) is not a standard formula. Confirmed Hours/Capacity (C) measures soft commitments. (Allocated + Confirmed)/Capacity (D) is the Forecasted Utilization formula.

questions.stem: The RIDAC workflow can be modified by using which recommended feature?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > RIDAC > Workflow Modification: The RIDAC workflow can be modified using Flow Designer (B), which is the recommended modern feature for workflow customization in ServiceNow. Per platform best practices, Flow Designer replaces the legacy Workflow Editor for creating and modifying workflows. Project Form (A) and Service Catalog (C) are not workflow tools. Workflow Editor (D) is the legacy tool, not the recommended approach.

questions.stem: Which stage of the Now Create methodology includes Transition, Mobilize, Prepare and Conduct?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Now Create > Methodology Stage: The Prepare stage (A) of the Now Create methodology includes Transition, Mobilize, Prepare, and Conduct activities. The Now Create implementation methodology structures project delivery into defined stages, with the Prepare stage encompassing the listed activities. Transition (B), Initiate (C), and Close (D) are other stages of the methodology.

questions.stem: Using the Request type field on a resource plan, which options can be used to request a resource? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Request Type Options: The resource plan Request type field options for requesting a resource are Person Days (B), Hours (C), and FTE (D). These three request types allow project managers to specify resource demand in different units. Day (A) and Month (E) are time period granularities, not standard resource request type values in ServiceNow PPM.

questions.stem: A checklist item record provides a name and what other element?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Checklist Items: A checklist item record provides a name and a Complete field (C) that can be set to true or false. Per p1051: 'a checklist item record provides only a name and a Complete field, which can be set to true or false.' Status field (A), Percent complete field (B), and Short description field (D) are not part of the default checklist item record.

questions.stem: In which table can you find cost information for a specific fiscal period?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Fiscal Period Cost Data: Cost information for a specific fiscal period is found in the cost_plan_breakdown table (A). Per p949: 'Cost Plan Breakdown [cost_plan_breakdown] table: Cost plan breakdowns specify the estimated cost and actual cost at a granular level for a fiscal period.' expense_line (B) stores actual incurred costs. pm_project (C) is the project table. cost_plan (D) stores the overall plan, not period-level breakdowns.

questions.stem: When copying a source project to a target project, what fields are copied by default? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Copy Default Fields: When copying a source project, the fields copied by default are Planned dates (A), Short description (C), and Duration fields (D). Per p1064: 'By default only the short description, planned dates and duration fields are copied from source project to the target project.' Number (B) is auto-generated for the new project. State (E) is reset to the default initial state.

questions.stem: The color band at the top of the project card in Project Workspace displays what project attribute?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Card Color Band: The color band at the top of the project card displays the project Status (A). The status color (e.g., green for On Track, yellow for At Risk, red for Off Track) provides a quick visual health indicator. Issues (B) and Risk (C) are related fields but not what the color band represents. State (D) is the workflow state of the project record.

questions.stem: Demand assessments are triggered as soon as the demand enters what state?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Assessment Trigger State: Demand assessments are triggered when the demand enters the Screening state (D). Per p961: 'The demand manager can screen the demand and send surveys to stakeholders to complete assessments.' The Screening state is where the demand manager reviews and sends assessment surveys. Submitted (A) is the initial state. Qualified (B) and Approved (C) come after screening.

questions.stem: Idea [im_idea_core] is directly extended from which table?

options.text: It is not extended from any table

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Ideas > Table Hierarchy: The Idea [im_idea_core] table is directly extended from the Task table (C). The Idea table inherits Task table fields and behaviors, making ideas trackable work items in ServiceNow. Project (A) is a separate table also extending Task. Idea Modules (B) are configuration records. The table does have a parent (D is false).

questions.stem: Is resource capacity derived from FTE or schedules?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Capacity Source: Resource capacity is derived from schedules only (A). Per p1402: 'Capacity is not derived from FTE, but from schedules. Both FTE and schedules must be in synchronization with each other.' FTE is used for planned hours calculation but not capacity. Neither (B), Only FTE (C), and Both (D) are incorrect — schedules are the sole source of capacity.

questions.stem: What are the allocation types available under the Allocation Config tab on a resource plan? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Allocation Config Types: The allocation types under the Allocation Config tab on a resource plan are Plan duration (A), Weekly (B), and Monthly (E). Per p1468/p1431: allocation types include Plan Duration (one record for entire duration), Weekly (one per week), and Monthly (one per month). Daily (C) and Yearly (D) are not allocation type options.

questions.stem: What role is required to view the Details tab of a project in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Details Tab Role: The it_project_user role (C) is required to view the Details tab of a project in Project Workspace. Per p1350: 'Role required: it_project_user' for the Details tab in project workspace. it_project_workspace_user (A) is not a standard role. it_project_manager (B) also has access but is not the minimum. it_project (D) is not a role name.

questions.stem: What must a resource plan contain if a resource plan is associated with a time card?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Time Card Association: A resource plan must contain hard allocation bookings (B) if it is associated with a time card. Per p1422: 'A resource plan can be associated with a time card only if the resource plan contains hard allocations for the user.' Front load spread (A) and Even spread (C) are allocation patterns. Soft allocation bookings (D) are insufficient for time card association.

questions.stem: Which work artifacts can be used to define the scope of a release? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Releases > Scope Artifacts: Work artifacts that can define the scope of a release are Defects (B), Enhancements (C), and Projects (D). These three artifact types can be included in a release scope to track what work is being delivered. Portfolios (A) are higher-level organizational constructs and Demands (E) are pre-project items, not typically release scope artifacts.

questions.stem: When creating a program, which of the following cannot be part of multiple programs? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Programs > Multi-Program Restriction: A project (C) and demand (D) cannot be part of multiple programs. Per p1537: 'A project or demand cannot be part of multiple programs.' Tasks (A) can be part of multiple contexts. Portfolio (B) restriction is that a program cannot be part of multiple portfolios — not that portfolios can't be part of multiple programs.

questions.stem: Which of the following defines a parent-child relationship? (Choose two.)

options.text: A parent-child task must finish before another begins.
Parent-child task relationships do not have any effect on task time constraints.
Any number of child tasks can be nested under a parent task with or without any dependencies.
A parent-child relationship is not saved as a record in any table.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Parent-Child Relationships: A parent-child relationship allows any number of child tasks nested under a parent (C) and is not saved as a record in any table (D). Per p1043: parent-child task relationships create WBS hierarchy without a separate relationship record. A parent-child relationship does not enforce sequential execution (A is false). Parent-child relationships DO affect task time constraints through rollup (B is false).

questions.stem: When a user's schedule changes, what action needs to be taken to update their existing data?

options.text: Update calendar manually to reflect the changed capacity

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Schedule Change Update: When a user's schedule changes, the resource manager must update capacity via 'Update Resource Capacity' (D). Per p1436: 'Update the resource capacity' related link recalculates capacity based on the new schedule across all resource aggregate tables. Manual calendar updates (A) and project plan updates (B) alone are insufficient. No action (C) would leave stale capacity data.

questions.stem: If a resource plan is not associated manually to a time card, then a resource plan is auto-associated. The auto-association is done based on which of the following in the time card?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Auto-Association: If a resource plan is not manually associated with a time card, auto-association is done based on the selected Task in the time card (A). Per p1422: 'The auto-association is done based on the selected Task in the time card.' Hard allocation (B) is a prerequisite for association eligibility but not the basis for auto-association. Soft allocation (C) and resource type (D) are not used for auto-association.

questions.stem: Which table would an admin modify in order to add extra columns to the side panel or remove default column choices on the Prioritization page within the Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Prioritization Columns: To add extra columns or remove default column choices on the Prioritization page, an admin modifies the Planning Item [sn_align_core_planning_item] table (C). Per p34: 'update the view configuration of the Planning Item [sn_align_core_planning_item] table' for portfolios with multiple item types. sn_align_ws_portfolio_plan (A) is the portfolio plan table. sn_align_cmn_int_choice_map (B) is for choice maps. sn_align_core_lens (D) is the lens configuration table.

questions.stem: Project score is calculated based on the individual scores of the following attributes: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Scoring > Score Formula: Project score is calculated based on Value Score (A) and Risk Score (B). Per p1021: 'Score: The demand score is calculated based on the individual scores of the following attributes' including value score and risk score. Alignment Score (C) and Strategy Score (D) may be separate scoring framework attributes but are not the two components of the base project score formula.

questions.stem: Which is an example of an offset type on a monetary benefit plan?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Benefit Plans > Offset Types: Start Date (A) is an example of an offset type on a monetary benefit plan. Per p1028: 'Offset type field indicates when the benefits start realizing.' Start Date and End Date are standard offset type values — when the project/demand start or end date changes, the benefit plan start date shifts accordingly. Rate Card (B), Risk (C), and Cost (D) are not offset types.

questions.stem: A customer requires five (5) teamspaces to support different departments. What should you do?

options.text: Contact the Account Representative to activate the teamspaces.
Use UI Policies and Business Rules to enable teamspaces.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Teamspaces > Activation: To support five teamspaces for different departments, activate via each teamspace plugin (B). Per p1137: individual plugins exist for each teamspace (PPM Teamspace 1-5: com.snc.ppm_teamspace_1 through _5) that must be separately activated. Account Representative contact (A) is not needed. UI Policies/Business Rules (C) cannot activate applications. A single teamspace property (D) cannot enable multiple teamspaces.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the default schedule for the Project Management application?

options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday. Includes the child schedule U.S. Holidays.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 9:00am to 5:00pm.
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Default Schedule: The default schedule for Project Management repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm (B). This 8-hour workday with lunch break is the standard default schedule. Option A includes US Holidays child schedule. Option C uses 9-5 without lunch break. Option D lacks specific time windows.

questions.stem: Which role should be given to users such as portfolio or product managers, so they can create, update, and delete, portfolio plans?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > User Role: The Portfolio Planning user [sn_align_core.apw_user] role (D) should be given to portfolio/product managers to create, update, and delete portfolio plans. Per p183: 'Portfolio Planning user [sn_align_core.apw_user] Can create, update, and delete portfolio plans.' The apw_admin role (A) has broader admin access. Milestones editor (B) and viewer (C) are for milestone management only.

questions.stem: What are some basics of Demand Management? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use the Project Workspace to compare and assess demands

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demand Management > Basics: Basics of Demand Management include the ability to promote demands to defects (A) and create stakeholders (C). Demand Management allows converting approved demands into artifacts including defects, and stakeholder creation is part of demand management governance. Using Project Workspace to compare demands (B) is not a Demand Management basic. Submit ideas (D) is Innovation Management, which precedes Demand Management.

questions.stem: In the default system, when working with demands, what two assessment metrics are supported when taking an assessment survey? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demands > Assessment Survey Metrics: The two default assessment metrics supported for demand assessment surveys are Risk (A) and Strategic Alignment (B). Per p959: these are assessment metric categories with survey-based scoring. Risk uses the Rating field from assessment results; Strategic Alignment uses assessment category results. Cost (C) is not a survey-based metric. Size (D) is a T-Shirt size field, not a survey metric.

questions.stem: What is the formula for Forecasted Utilization?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Forecasted Utilization: The formula for Forecasted Utilization is (Allocated Hours + Confirmed Hours) / Capacity (C). This includes both hard-allocated and confirmed (soft-committed) hours as a proportion of total capacity. Assigned Hours/Capacity (A) is not a standard formula. Confirmed Hours/Capacity (B) omits allocated hours. Allocated Hours/Capacity (D) is the Committed Utilization formula.

questions.stem: Resource plan costs are divided into: (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Resource Plan Costs: Resource plan costs are divided into Planned Cost (A), Allocated Cost (B), and Actual Cost (C). Per p1403: 'The aggregated costs for all resource plans roll up to the Planned Cost and Allocated Cost fields' along with Actual Cost in project/demand financials. Expense Cost (D) is a separate cost type for non-resource expenses. Forecast Cost (E) is not a standard resource plan cost division.

questions.stem: What UI Actions are available to link RIDAC records? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > RIDAC > UI Actions: The UI Actions to link RIDAC records are Associate RIDAC (B) and Convert to RIDAC (C). Per p1111: 'Associate RIDAC related link' associates one RIDAC record to another. Per p1104: convert operations allow converting one RIDAC type to another in sequence. Apply Template (A) and Save as New Template (E) are template operations. View RIDAC (D) is a navigation action, not a linking action.

questions.stem: Which system property needs to be set to True to be able to allocate budgets in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Budget Allocation Property: The system property to enable budget allocation in Project Workspace is sn_invst_pln.enable_budget_allocation_v2 (C). Per p323: 'locate and open sn_invst_pln.enable_budget_allocation_v2 property. Update the Value field to True.' sn_plng_att_core.default.expense_type (A) sets expense type defaults. sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute (B) configures the allocation attribute. com.snc.project.rollup.cost (D) controls cost rollup.

questions.stem: How can the latest financial forecasts (actuals or planned costs) be compared to initial planned costs month over month in the new Project Workspace?

options.text: Using the Cost plan breakdown form

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Financial Comparison: The project Details page (D) allows comparison of latest financial forecasts to initial planned costs month over month. Per p25/p266: the Details tab provides high-level financial forecast entry and comparison capabilities showing actuals for past periods and planned costs for future periods. Cost plan breakdown form (A) shows period granularity. Financials Cost page (B) shows current costs. Compare Baselines page (C) compares baseline snapshots.

questions.stem: At which point in the Demand Management lifecycle do assessments get sent to stakeholders?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demand Management > Assessment Trigger: Assessments are sent to stakeholders during the Screening state (D). Per p961: 'The demand manager can screen the demand and send surveys to stakeholders to complete assessments.' Screening is where the demand manager reviews the demand and distributes assessment surveys. Creation (A) is the initial Draft state. Assessment (B) is not a standard demand lifecycle state. Planning (C) occurs after approval.

questions.stem: What are the available resource states in the Resource status field on the New Resource Assignment form? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Resource Assignment States: The available resource states on the New Resource Assignment form are Unassigned (D), Pending (E), Approved (F), and Unapproved (G). Per p1423: Planned/Requested plans map to Unassigned; Allocated/Confirmed plans map to Approved. Per p1374: 'status of the assignment is moved to pending... once reviewed and... approved or unapproved.' Cancelled (A), In Progress (B), and Open (C) are not valid resource assignment states.

questions.stem: What can be used to derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for calculating planned and actual resource costs for a project or demand?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Rate Model: A rate model (B) derives date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for calculating planned and actual resource costs. Per p1552: 'Use a rate model to derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for calculating planned and actual resource costs for a project or demand.' Unlike labor rates (user attribute only), a rate model supports up to ten attributes. A time card (A) tracks actual hours. Resource assignments (C) and rate types (D) are not used for rate derivation.

questions.stem: What determines the resource schedule if the Schedules related list and Schedule field are both empty?

options.text: Average Daily FTE Hours/Hours Per Person Day (com.snc.resource_management.average_daily_fte) property

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Default Schedule Fallback: If both the Schedules related list and Schedule field are empty, the Default Schedule Name property (com.snc.resource_management.default_schedule) (A) determines the resource schedule. Per p1438: 'If the Schedule field is empty too, then the schedule specified in the Default Schedule Name...property is applied as the resource schedule.' Effort type (B) is not a schedule source. Default PM Schedule (C) applies to projects. Average Daily FTE (D) determines planned hours, not the schedule.

questions.stem: Which field must be populated to request a person with a specific role when creating a resource assignment?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Role Request Field: The Role field (D) must be populated to request a person with a specific role when creating a resource assignment. Per p1465: the Role field on the resource assignment form specifies 'Role of the resources to associate with the plan.' Skill (A) is for skill-based requests. Group (B) is for group-based requests. Resource (C) is for specific person requests — populating it auto-populates group, role, and skill fields.

questions.stem: What plugin must be installed to use Capacity Planning in a portfolio?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Capacity Plugin: The Portfolio Planning plugin (B) must be installed to use Capacity Planning in a portfolio. Per p3: Portfolio Planning is the application that provides capacity planning capabilities within portfolio plans. Collaborative Work Management (A) is for agile/sprint planning. Skills Management (C) manages resource skills. Time Card Management (D) is for time tracking.

questions.stem: What are the characteristics of the default Resource Management schedule? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Default Schedule: The default Resource Management schedule characteristics are Monday-Friday 13:00-17:00 (C), Weekly on Weekdays (D), and Monday-Friday 08:00-12:00 (E). Per p1049: 'work hours are Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 with an hour break from noon to 13:00' — yielding two time windows (08:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00) repeating weekly on weekdays. Saturday (A) is not part of the default schedule. 8-5 excluding holidays (B) is a different schedule variant.

questions.stem: What role must be assigned to users to be considered for resource planning?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Resource Role: The pps_resource role (B) must be assigned to users to be considered for resource planning. Per p1817: 'PPS resource [pps_resource] Only users with this role...' Per p1436: 'Resource Manager view lists only the users who have the pps_resource role.' timecard_user (A) is for time card access. resource_user (C) creates resource plans. resource_manager (D) manages allocations but is not required for users to appear as assignable resources. rate_model_user (E) is not standard.

questions.stem: What provides a centralized view of the resource allocations and resource requests?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Centralized Resource View: Resource Management Workspace (B) provides the centralized view of resource allocations and resource requests across projects. Per p1367: Resource Management Workspace is specifically designed for centralized resource management across planning items. Project Management Workspace (A) is project-scoped. Capacity Planning (C) is for capacity analysis. Resource Assignments (D) is a table/list, not a centralized workspace.

questions.stem: Which role does a group need for selection in a resource assignment?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Group Role for Assignment: A group needs the pps_resource role (B) for selection in a resource assignment. Per p1321: 'Assign the pps_resource role to a group required for group-based resource assignment.' Per p1436: 'a resource manager might need to work with an administrator to add users to a group with pps_resource role.' resource_manager (A) manages allocations. itil (C) is a general ITSM role. it_project_user (D) is a project viewer, not required for group resource assignment.

questions.stem: What role can create or modify a rate model?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Rate Model Role: The push_admin role (C) can create or modify a rate model. Rate models derive date-effective, criteria-driven hourly rates for resource cost calculations per p1552. it_pps_admin (A) manages project administration settings. time_card_admin (B) manages time card policies. release_admin (D) manages releases and is unrelated to rate model creation.

questions.stem: At a minimum, which role is required to update a project task in Project Workspace?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Task Update Role: The minimum role required to update a project task in Project Workspace is itil (C). The itil role provides write access to task-based records including project tasks which extend the Task table. it_project_user (A) has additional project-specific permissions but itil is the minimum. it_project_manager (B) has full project management access. it_portfolio_manager (D) is for portfolio management.

questions.stem: Which of these items should implementers create/configure first during an SPM implementation?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Implementation > First Configuration: Lenses (D) should be created/configured first during SPM implementation. Lenses define the strategic planning hierarchy and are foundational to all other SPM configurations — establishing the organizational structure (goals, strategies, objectives) that other artifacts reference. Demand management (A) and Dashboards (B) are later-stage configurations. Business units (C) may be configured early but are not the primary first SPM-specific item.

questions.stem: Which colors are used as indicators of project health in a project status report? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Status Report Colors: The colors used as indicators of project health in a project status report are Yellow (A), Red (B), and Green (C). Per p1546: 'The status is indicated using red, green, and yellow colors by default.' This standard traffic-light system applies to overall health, schedule, cost, resources, and scope. Orange (D) and Blue (E) are not default health indicator colors in SPM status reports.

questions.stem: Which role provides edit access so users can generate capacity planning in Portfolio Planning Workspace?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Capacity Edit Role: The sn_align_ws.spw_capacity_user role (A) provides edit access for generating capacity planning in Portfolio Planning Workspace. Per SPM role naming conventions, spw_capacity_user grants edit access while spw_capacity_read (B) provides read-only access. sn_align_ws.spw_financial_user (C) is for financial planning. sn_align_core.ap_read_only (D) provides read-only access to portfolio plans, not edit access for capacity planning.

questions.stem: When creating a planning item, which fields are populated automatically with the Approved start date value and the Approved end date value respectively? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Approved Date Mapping: When creating a planning item, Planned start date (B) is populated from the Approved start date and Planned end date (C) from the Approved end date. Per p196/p516: 'Planned start date...This value is copied from the Approved start date field. Planned end date...This value is copied from the Approved end date field.' Actual start date (A) is set when work begins. Due date (D) is not auto-populated from approved dates.

questions.stem: Which resource tasks can be completed in Project Workspace? (Choose two.)

options.text: Allocate a resource creating a named-resource assignment
Request a resource using role, group, or skill

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Resource Tasks: In Project Workspace, project managers can allocate a resource via named-resource assignment (B) and request a resource using role, group, or skill (E). Per p1243: 'The Resource Management application enables Project Managers to create resource assignments, allocate resources, and analyze resource availability in Project Workspace.' Creating a resource calendar (A) is an admin task. Viewing requests (C) and capacity (D) are done in Resource Management Workspace.

questions.stem: Which personas can request an attribute-based resource assignment? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Attribute-Based Assignments: The personas that can request attribute-based resource assignments are Demand manager (A) and Project manager (B). Per p897/p941: project managers and demand managers are the primary users of resource planning in SPM. Idea managers (C) work with idea submissions, not resource assignments. Business stakeholders (D) can view capacity but are not requesters of attribute-based resource assignments.

questions.stem: Which options are available in the ‘Effort type’ field on the Resource Assignments form, when requesting resources? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Effort Types: The available options in the Effort type field on the Resource Assignments form are Person days (A), Hours (C), and FTE (E). Per p1339: 'Effort Type: If you select any of the following choices, then a field is displayed for that choice: Hours, FTE, Person days.' Group (B) is a resource selection type, not an effort type. Weekly on weekdays (D) is a schedule setting, not an effort type.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow application interacts with SPM through risk assessments?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Integrations > Risk Assessments: IT Service Management (D) interacts with SPM through risk assessments. Risk assessment functionality in Change Management (part of ITSM) integrates with SPM for evaluating project and demand risks. Field Service Management (A) and DevOps (C) have separate SPM integrations unrelated to risk assessments. Governance Risk and Compliance (B) has its own risk module but interacts with SPM differently.

questions.stem: What is used to generate labor cost if a project or demand does not have an associated rate model?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Labor Cost Fallback: If a project or demand does not have an associated rate model, the default labor rate (C) is used to generate labor costs. Per p1461: 'The hourly rate is derived from: Rate model (if populated)... Labor rate card (if rate model not available)... System property com.snc.time_card.default_rate if all other conditions fail.' Default Resource Management Schedule (A) determines working hours, not labor cost rates.

questions.stem: Where can a project manager go to view quick reports of time card exceptions, and category wise time reported for their projects?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Time Sheets > Analytics Project Manager: To view quick reports of time card exceptions and category-wise time for projects, navigate to Analytics Project manager (C). Per p1596: 'Navigate to All > Time Sheets > Analytics Project manager. Select a project and date range... Review the displayed reports and take necessary actions.' User metrics dashboard (A) and PMO dashboard (B) are different views. Analytics Time sheet (D) is not a standard module name.

questions.stem: How can cost plans be generated from resource assignments? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the ‘Generate labor costs’ button on Project Workspace
Update the appropriate Resource Management property
Run a scheduled job to automatically generate labor costs from resource assignments
Select the ‘Generate cost’ button in Resource Management Workspace

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Generate Labor Costs Methods: Cost plans can be generated from resource assignments by selecting the Generate labor costs button in Project Workspace (A) and running a scheduled job to automatically generate labor costs (C). Per p487: 'Generate Labor Costs: Activate scheduled jobs to automatically generate labor costs for attribute-based resource assignments for Projects and Demands.' Updating a property (B) enables the feature but does not generate costs. No Generate cost button (D) exists in Resource Management Workspace.

questions.stem: Where can custom risk ranks and value scores (such as High-Medium, Medium-Low, or Absolute-Low) be configured to evaluate the impact and probability of a risk?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > RIDAC > Risk Value Lookup: Custom risk ranks and value scores (High-Medium, Medium-Low, Absolute-Low) are configured in the Risk Value Lookup module (B). Per p1106: 'Use the Risk Value Lookup module to set up the risk rank and risk value for a specific combination of risk impact and probability. The system uses these values to determine the degree of risk based on impact and probability factors.' The Risk form (D) displays calculated values but is not where custom ranks are configured.

questions.stem: Which options can budget be allocated by, when setting the 'sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute' property? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Portfolio Planning > Budget Allocation Attribute: The sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute property can allocate budget by Cost type (B) or Expense type (D). Per p1251: 'Update the Value field to one of the following: cost_type — view financials by cost types such as Hardware Opex, External labor Capex; expense_type — view financials by expense types such as Capex and Opex.' Budget cost (A) and Employee type (C) are not valid values for this property.

questions.stem: Which field on the Idea Module form displays the unique identifier for the module, that is used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL to direct users?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Innovation > Idea Module ID: The Module ID field (A) on the Idea Module form displays the unique identifier used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL to direct users. Per p939: 'Module Id: Unique identifier for the module used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL. For example, if you use hr as the Module Id, the URL would be: /idea/?id=ideas_list&sysparm_module_id=hr.' Idea Table (B) specifies the storage table. Module Name (C) is the display name. Category Limit (D) controls idea categories.

questions.stem: A project expense line is a cost associated with a specific source. Examples of specific sources could include: (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Expense Line Sources: A project expense line is a cost associated with specific sources such as Configuration Item (A), User (C), and Fixed Asset (E). Per p977: 'A demand expense line is the cost associated with a specific source, such as a user or a fixed asset' — applicable to projects as well. Expense lines reference source records in the platform. Demand (B) is a planning item, not a cost source. Project (D) is the planning item itself, not an expense source.

questions.stem: How can project managers be restricted from creating resource assignments with named resources?

options.text: Create an Access Control List (ACL) rule
Create a reference qualifier on the 'assigned to' field
The system automatically does this and can only be disabled by an admin

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Named Resource Restriction: Project managers can be restricted from creating resource assignments with named resources by creating an ACL rule (A). ACLs provide fine-grained access control over record operations including create/write on specific fields or conditions. A business rule (B) executes server-side logic but is not the standard mechanism for restricting UI access. A reference qualifier (C) filters lookup choices but does not prevent record creation. The system (D) does not automatically restrict this.

questions.stem: Which of the following tasks can be performed when Innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request? (Choose two.)

options.text: Create a project from a universal request
Create an idea from a universal request
Transfer an idea to another department
Send a universal request to a demand manager for review

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Innovation > Universal Request Integration: With Innovation Management integrated with Universal Request, users can create an idea from a universal request (B) and transfer an idea to another department (C). Per p913: 'Create an idea from a universal request and manage your ideas. Transfer an idea to another department if the idea is rejected.' Per p929: Universal Request integration facilitates inter-department transfers. Creating a project from a UR (A) and sending UR to demand manager (D) are not specific to this integration.

questions.stem: An it_project_manager can request resources by which of the following: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Resource Request Effort Types: A project manager can request resources by Person Days (B) and Hours (D). Per p1339: Effort Type options on the Resource Assignments form are Hours, FTE, and Person days. Per p1470: allocation records can be Monthly, Weekly, or Plan Duration — but Month (A) and Day (C) are not valid Effort Type options for resource requests.

questions.stem: What system role is needed to manage programs?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Programs > Program Manager Role: The it_program_manager role (B) is needed to manage programs. Per p1958: 'Program manager [it_program_manager]: Users with this role have full control on all the scrum programs.' it_portfolio_manager_admin (A) manages portfolio administration. it_project_manager (C) manages projects, not programs. it_program_manager_admin (D) is not a standard role name in SPM.

questions.stem: In order for a business unit to have its own Idea Portal to retrieve data, what must be configured first?

options.text: A business unit cannot have its own Idea Portal

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Innovation > Idea Module Prerequisite: An Idea module (A) must be configured first for a business unit to have its own Idea Portal. Per p924/p939: the Idea Module configures the unique Module Id used as a parameter in the Idea Portal URL, enabling business unit-specific portals. Per p916: configuring idea categories with the Idea module is required to fetch categories in the portal. Idea categories (C) and the portal URL (D) require the module to be configured first.

questions.stem: Which formats can data be exported to from the Resource Management Workspace? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Export Formats: Data from Resource Management Workspace can be exported in CSV (A) and Excel (C) formats. Per p1316: 'In the Export side panel, select Excel or CSV from the File type list' for exporting from Project Workspace. These are the standard supported export formats in ServiceNow SPM workspaces. JPEG (B) is an image format not supported for data export. PPT (D) is a presentation format not supported.

questions.stem: Which conditions must be met in order to change the planned start date of a project? (Choose two.)

options.text: project_funding records are selected for execution
Project actual dates are not populated
The state of a project is Pending or Open
The state of the project is Closed Skipped

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Planned Start Date Change Conditions: To change the planned start date of a project, actual dates must not be populated (B) and the project state must be Pending or Open (C). Per p1088: 'Change the planned start date of a project... Adjust the schedule of a project by changing the planned start date.' Projects in Closed states (D) cannot have planned start dates changed. project_funding records (A) are not a prerequisite for changing planned start dates.

questions.stem: What actions can a project manager perform related to Agile projects on the Details page of Project Workspace? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Project Workspace > Agile Details Page: On the Details page for Agile projects, a project manager can create a new Agile phase (A), add stories (C), and create a Doc page (E). Per p1264: the Details page allows editing project phases, requirements, and documentation. Viewing widgets and reports (B) is done via the Analytics page. Viewing WBS (D) is specific to Waterfall projects. Removing epics (F) is performed from the planning page.

questions.stem: Which status is a resource assignment created in if the assignment is for a user or group?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Resources > Initial Assignment Status: A resource assignment created for a user or group starts in Pending status (C). Per p1374: 'the status of the assignment is moved to pending, indicating resource manager about the review required for the changes made.' Per p1384: 'The assigned work... will be in Pending state.' Approved (A) requires resource manager review. Unapproved (B) results from rejected assignments. Unassigned (D) is for unallocated open request slots.

questions.stem: What are the default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Projects > Default Template Config Records: The default project template configuration records in the Template Config module are Project (B), Project subtask (E), and Project task (G). Per p1115: 'Navigate to All > Project Administration > Settings > Template Config to display the Project Template Configuration list.' These three records define the default template structure. Task (A) is a generic table. Project template (C), Program task (D), Portfolio task (F) are not default template config records.

questions.stem: The PPM Standard plugin enables an it_project_manager to perform the following activities: (Choose three.)

options.text: Track actual amount spent compared to an approved budget.
Establish resource requirements and track costs.

questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > PPM Standard > Project Manager Activities: The PPM Standard plugin enables it_project_manager to track actual amount spent vs approved budget (A), determine overall project cost requirements (C), and establish resource requirements and track costs (E). These are core project financial and resource management activities. Configure cost type definition (B) is an admin task. Define target for the portfolio (D) is a portfolio manager activity, not a project manager activity.

questions.stem: What artifacts can be created from a demand? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SPM > Demand Management > Artifacts from Demand: The artifacts that can be created from a demand are Change (B), Project (D), and Defect (E). Per p961: 'The demand manager creates a project, enhancement, change, defect, or EAP entities' as demand outcomes. Resource (A) is not a demand artifact — it is allocated to demands. Task (C) is not a standalone artifact created from a demand; project tasks are created within projects that may originate from demands.
